title: Annotatio IV §.X: Yet some hold Eucharistic truth — Gelasius (near-first papal name)
pass_a_gloss: yet there were even in this Age some who adhered more constantly also to the Eucharistic truth. Among these GELASIUS is to be numbered almost the first both of this name and of Papal dignity, in a certain writing of whose, opposed to Eutyches and Nestorius, but alleged by Gratian, de Consecrat. Distinct. 2. cap. 12., we read among other things these sayings that make for the truth and against Transubstantiation:
pass_b_english: Yet even in this age some clung more constantly to Eucharistic truth.
Among them GELASIUS — almost first of the papal name and dignity — in a writing against Eutyches and Nestorius (Gratian, de Consecrat. Dist. 2 c. 12), for truth and against Transubstantiation.
source_text: fuerunt tamen etiam hộc Seculô nonnulli, qui & veritati Eucharisticæ constantiores adhesêre. Hos inter GELASIUS & nominis hujus & dignitatis Papalis propemodum primus numerandus, in cujus scripto quodam, Eutychi & Nestorio opposito, à Gratiano verò allegato, de Consecrat. Distinct. 2. cap. 12. hæc inter alia legimus, pro veritate, & contra Transsubstantiationem, facientia:
